what: Agents in flight, and why. A finished agent is REMOVED from this file, not marked done — the page shows what is happening now, and history lives in git.

agents.what: Funds we hide because one round closed, while the programme runs on
agents.why: We record a funding round; the funder runs a programme that reopens. When the round's date passes we stop offering it — so a French agency is taking applications today for a scheme we marked shut in March 2024. Eleven of fifteen rows checked against the funders' own pages are live or reopening. The founder should see the fund and be told the window has closed, which is more useful than hiding it and more honest than showing it as open.

agents.what: Clear out the workings so the findings can be found
agents.why: Two hundred and eighteen research notes and a hundred scratch scripts have piled up, and the risk is not disk space — it is someone paying again for an answer we already have, or quoting a figure that was true a week ago. The job is to sort what is a paid measurement's only record from what is genuinely spent, write an index of the first, and delete the second.
